concerns.text: Task T006a mandates loading a sample from 'ChestX-ray14' to validate the ViQ encoder. This directly violates Spec FR-003 and Constitution Principle VI, which explicitly exclude ChestX-ray14 from all study steps. The task introduces a forbidden dataset dependency.

Tasks T022 and T028 implement a 'paired t-test/Wilcoxon' on single-distribution metrics (texture complexity vs error, or high-res vs low-res means) without defining the paired samples. Spec SC-004 requires comparing error distributions (implying paired low-res vs high-res errors for the same image), but the tasks do not specify the logic to pair these samples, rendering the statistical test scientifically invalid and the acceptance criteria untestable.

Task T019 requires reading 'native 1024x1024 ground truth images directly from data/raw/' without specifying extraction or validation logic. This violates Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) which forbids modifying raw data and requires checksummed, immutable raw archives. The task assumes raw archives contain ready-to-read 1024x1024 images without defining the transformation pipeline to `data/processed/`.

Task T006b generates pivot files upon T006a failure but does not include a step to update `spec.md` or `plan.md` to reflect the pivot. This violates Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) and the 'No silent constitution drift' rule, as the project would proceed with a failed hypothesis while the official documentation remains unchanged.

Task T021 calculates mean PSNR/SSIM but does not include the logic to calculate or store per-image texture complexity values. Spec SC-001 requires a Spearman correlation between texture complexity and reconstruction error. Without storing the per-image complexity values, the correlation analysis mandated by SC-001 cannot be performed, dropping the acceptance criterion.
